name: claim1_ladder_coast
comment: Claim 1 as a ladder. Same problem, budget (proposals) and decision rule; arms add one thing at a time: random_mutation (no model) < single_agent (one strong call) < researcher_plain (one strong call that names its idea's source) < researcher_memory (+ notebook) / researcher_search (+ ideas board from search) < researcher_full (both). pipeline is the first design (analyst, scout, engineer), kept as the documented negative result that motivated the ladder. Read both the equal-proposals and the equal-dollars views. Seeds: five for single_agent, researcher_plain and researcher_memory (three were added after two seeds proved too noisy to rank them); two for the other arms.

target.rule: time to target: confirm loss at or below (1 - rel) x the starting formula's (seed's) generation-0 confirm loss
target.comment: Fixed before any result, by the experiment protocol. Read only by lab.experiments.report; the runner ignores this key.

arms.name: random_mutation
arms.comment: No model: constants perturbed or one term dropped.

arms.name: single_agent
arms.comment: One strong call per proposal: description, incumbent, digest.

arms.name: pipeline
arms.comment: The first design: analyst, closed-book, scout, engineer; vector memory, OpenAlex then arXiv.

arms.name: researcher_plain
arms.comment: Researcher with nothing extra: single_agent plus a strategy suggestion, a repair attempt and the header lines.

arms.name: researcher_memory
arms.comment: Researcher + the notebook (vector recall). Source of the warm arms in claim2_transfer_turb_v2.

arms.name: researcher_search
arms.comment: Researcher + the ideas board scouted from OpenAlex (arXiv if it fails).
